gloss: new work, new creation, latest release

definitions.gloss: new work, new creation, latest release
definitions.explanation: A newly created or recently released work, such as a movie, book, clothing item, or other product.

examples.japanese: {新作|しんさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ドレス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}された→発表：03562_happyou⟧。

notes:
{新作|しんさく} refers to a newly created or recently released work. It is used broadly for movies, books, music, games, fashion, food items, and other creative or commercial products.

FORMS:
{新|しん} (new) + {作|さく} (work, creation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新作|しんさく}{映画|えいが}: new movie
- {新作|しんさく}{小説|しょうせつ}: new novel
- {新作|しんさく}ゲーム: new game
- {新作|しんさく}メニュー: new menu items
- {新作|しんさく}を{発表|はっぴょう}する: to announce a new work

RELATED {作|さく} COMPOUNDS:
- {旧作|きゅうさく}: old/previous work
- {名作|めいさく}: masterpiece
- {大作|たいさく}: major work, epic
- {力作|りきさく}: work of great effort
- {傑作|けっさく}: masterpiece, great work
